scenario_title: Security group closed the election port
title: Connection failures on cloud-api
impact: Requests failed while connections were refused on cloud-api
symptom: [ANOMALY] cloud-api 2026-06-23 18:16-21:36: cloud-api: 298 of 363 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-23 18:16 and 2026-06-23 21:36 UTC (peak error ratio 0.96 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 1 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 1.955 s vs baseline band up to 0.453 s.
error_templates: Unexpected exception while calling compute-svc: ConnectionError: [Errno 111] Connection refused

_templates.macro: Terraform change to aws_security_group for coord-svc closed the leader-election port, so quorum peers could not open election channels.
_templates.remediation: Restore the ingress rule for port {old} on {resource} (terraform apply of {version_from}); add a connectivity check for 2181/2888/3888 to the pipeline.

rca.macro: Terraform change to aws_security_group for coord-svc closed the leader-election port, so quorum peers could not open election channels.
rca.micro: infra/coord-svc.tf:13 changes the election ingress rule sg_election_port 3888 -> 2888.
rca.remediation: Restore the ingress rule for port 3888 on aws_security_group.coord_svc (terraform apply of tf-r6); add a connectivity check for 2181/2888/3888 to the pipeline.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `<*> <*> <*> HTTP/1.1" status: <*> len: <*> time: <*>`.
